        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "plugin.yaml + server.*\n        │\n        ▼\nloadPluginManifest(pluginDir)\n        │\n        ├─ 读取 plugin.yaml\n        ├─ yaml.UnmarshalStrict → spec.Plugin\n        ├─ filepath.Glob(pluginDir + \"/server.*\")\n        │    ├─ 0 个：保留 manifest 中原有的 command/args\n        │    ├─ 1 个：读取源码，写入 sidecar.container.args\n        │    └─ 多个：报错，停止构建\n        └─ p.Validate()\n        │\n        ▼\nplugin.ToConfigMap(p)\n        ├─ 再次校验 Plugin\n        ├─ 生成 kind: ConfigMap\n        ├─ name: <name>-executor-plugin\n        ├─ label: workflows.argoproj.io/configmap-type=ExecutorPlugin\n        └─ data: sidecar.container / sidecar.automountServiceAccountToken\n        │\n        ├─ saveConfigMap → <name>-executor-plugin-configmap.yaml\n        └─ saveReadme    → README.md\n\n<name>-executor-plugin-configmap.yaml\n        │\n        ▼\nkubectl apply\n        │\n        ▼\nController informer watch ConfigMap\n"
      })

        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {

      }), " 绑定，而不是与某一次插件请求绑定："]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这一节讨论的是一个常见场景：外部平台负责真正执行任务，Argo 只负责编排。比如机器学习平台接收到训练任务后，会在自己的系统中维护 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "queued"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "running"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "succeeded"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "failed"
      }), " 等状态；Argo 则需要根据这些状态决定后续 Workflow 是否可以继续。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "可以让 Workflow 把外部任务 ID 交给插件："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {

          children: "name:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "train-model"
        }), "\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",

        }), "\n      ", _jsx(_components.span, {

          className: "hljs-attr",

          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "train-20260808-001"
        }), "\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

        children: "NodeResult"
      }), "："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "argoexec agent main\n  -> POST /api/v1/template.execute\n     -> 插件读取 jobId=train-20260808-001\n     -> 插件调用外部平台 GET /api/jobs/train-20260808-001\n     -> 将 queued/running/succeeded/failed 映射为 NodeResult.phase\n  -> Agent 将 NodeResult 写入 responseQueue\n  -> patchWorker Patch WorkflowTaskSet.status.nodes\n  -> Argo Node 变为 Pending/Running/Succeeded/Failed\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里要区分两个 HTTP 接口：", _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.table, {

        }), " 类型标签，Controller 才会将它识别为插件。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "Controller 发现插件"
        }), "：Controller 通过 ConfigMap informer 监听 Add、Update、Delete 事件，将合法 ConfigMap 反序列化后写入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "executorPlugins"
        }), " 缓存。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "提交 Workflow"
        }), "：用户创建包含 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "templates[].plugin"
        }), " 的 Workflow。Controller watch 到 Workflow 后，在需要执行插件任务时通常为这个 Workflow 创建一个 Agent Pod，并从缓存中注入所需的多个插件 sidecar、地址和名称。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "Agent 建立调用链"
        }), "：Agent init 为插件生成 Token，main 容器读取插件地址和 Token，创建 RPC client，然后 watch 对应的 WorkflowTaskSet，将任务放入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "taskQueue"
        }), "。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "执行并返回结果"
        }), "：", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "taskWorker"
        }), " 消费任务，经过 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "processTask()"
        }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "executePluginTemplate()"
        }), " 向插件发送 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "template.execute"
        }), " 请求。插件查询外部系统后返回 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "NodeResult"
        }), " 和可选的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "requeue"
        }), "。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "回写 Node 状态"
        }), "：", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "taskWorker"
        }), " 将结果放入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "responseQueue"
        }), "，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "patchWorker"
        }), " 聚合后 Patch ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "WorkflowTaskSet.status.nodes"
        }), "，Controller 再据此推进 Argo Node 状态。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "继续轮询或结束"
        }), "：", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Pending"
        }), "/", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Running"
        }), " 必须配合 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "requeue"
        }), "，任务会重新进入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "taskQueue"
        }), "；", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Succeeded"
        }), "/", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Failed"
        }), " 等终态不再重新入队，Workflow 继续向后推进，Agent 最终随 WorkflowTaskSet 完成或删除而退出。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "附录源码索引",
      children: "附录：源码索引"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "本文以 Argo Workflows 源码中的以下文件为主："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cmd/argo/commands/executorplugin/io.go"
        }), "：读取 manifest、发现 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "server.*"
        })]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cmd/argo/commands/executorplugin/build.go"
        }), "：构建 ConfigMap 的 CLI 入口"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "workflow/util/plugins/configmap.go"
        }), "：Plugin 与 ConfigMap 的转换"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "workflow/controller/controller.go"
        }), "：ConfigMap informer 和插件缓存"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "workflow/controller/agent.go"
        }), "：Agent Pod、sidecar、Token 和环境变量注入"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cmd/argoexec/commands/agent.go"
        }), "：读取插件地址/Token，创建 RPC client"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "workflow/executor/agent.go"
        }), "：Agent、taskWorker、patchWorker、模板执行分派"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "workflow/executor/plugins/rpc/plugin.go"
        }), "：", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ExecuteTemplate"
        }), " 到 RPC method 的映射"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "workflow/util/plugins/plugin.go"
        }), "：HTTP 请求、认证、重试和状态码处理"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "pkg/plugins/executor/template_executor_plugin.go"
        }), "：插件请求/响应契约"]
      }), "\n"]
    })]
  });
}
function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};

  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
